item.text: I’m checking a protocol-specification mismatch in follower proposal handling: a redundant `PROPOSE` for the same zxid is only logged as a warning and still passed to `logRequest`, which can leave duplicate pending transactions. The supplied protocol specification explicitly says redundant proposals should be released/ignored.

item.text:
The report now contains fourteen reproduced findings at [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_08-26-31-zookeeper-baseline/work/report.md).

This continuation added **F14: redundant follower `PROPOSE` messages are not released and create duplicate pending transactions**. In [Follower.processPacket](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_08-26-31-zookeeper-baseline/work/zookeeper-server/src/main/java/org/apache/zookeeper/server/quorum/Follower.java:161), a non-consecutive zxid only produces a warning; `fzk.logRequest(...)` is still called. Two identical proposals consequently produce two pending transactions. The supplied protocol notes (`zookeeper-specifications/protocol-spec/issues.md`, Issue 2) explicitly say redundant proposals should be released.

The repro observed:

```
WARN ... Got zxid 0x5 expected 0x1
WARN ... Got zxid 0x5 expected 0x6
AssertionError: the same PROPOSE was delivered to logRequest twice instead of being released
```

Reproduction: [DuplicateProposalRepro.java](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_08-26-31-zookeeper-baseline/work/repro/duplicate_proposal/org/apache/zookeeper/server/quorum/DuplicateProposalRepro.java).

The other thirteen findings remain documented, including snapshot-fallback state leakage, malformed transaction handling, truncation/recovery boundary issues, epoch initialization failure, and orcale-related election/revalidation defects. All reproduction files and outputs are under `repro/`; the captured source remains unmodified.
